@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Michael's company had a p______s year. They earned a lot of money.
= prosperous
~詞義 prosperous（adj.）繁榮的
~原文 Michael's company had a prosperous year. They earned a lot of money.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Ben was extremely disappointed when he received the r______n letter from his dream university.
= rejection
~詞義 rejection（n.）拒絕
~原文 Ben was extremely disappointed when he received the rejection letter from his dream university.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The bag is made of g______e leather, so it is a bit more expensive than the other ones.
= genuine
~詞義 genuine（adj.）真的
~原文 The bag is made of genuine leather, so it is a bit more expensive than the other ones.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Jean s______es to improve her writing skills by reading widely and practicing daily, even when feeling tired.
= strives
~詞義 strive（v.）努力
~原文 Jean strives to improve her writing skills by reading widely and practicing daily, even when feeling tired.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Decisions made in i______e can cause serious harm, especially when people refuse to learn basic facts.
= ignorance
~詞義 ignorance（n.）無知
~原文 Decisions made in ignorance can cause serious harm, especially when people refuse to learn basic facts.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: When the fire alarm rings, everyone has to leave the building and ______ in the playground.
A: assemble
B: isolate
C: frustrate
D: dominate
= A
~詞義 assemble（v.）聚集
~原文 When the fire alarm rings, everyone has to leave the building and assemble in the playground.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The company surveyed the customers to collect their ______ on the new product.
A: intuition
B: frustration
C: maximum
D: feedback
= D
~詞義 feedback（n.）回饋
~原文 The company surveyed the customers to collect their feedback on the new product.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: You could include more ______ in your presentation to make it easier for people to understand the meaning of the data.
A: assemblies
B: choruses
C: funerals
D: diagrams
= D
~詞義 diagram（n.）圖表
~原文 You could include more diagrams in your presentation to make it easier for people to understand the meaning of the data.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Many teenagers are ______ to social media platforms, checking their phones even during important conversations.
A: addicted
B: exhausted
C: generous
D: brutal
= A
~詞義 addicted（adj.）成癮的
~原文 Many teenagers are addicted to social media platforms, checking their phones even during important conversations.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Adam can ______ an apple in half with his bare hands.
A: dread
B: crash
C: grieve
D: split
= D
~詞義 split（v.）分開
~原文 Adam can split an apple in half with his bare hands.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: dew
B: injected
C: maximum
D: grieved
E: psychology
F: furious

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: When the sun rose in the east, the ______ vanished from the tree leaves.
= A
~詞義 dew（n.）露水
~原文 When the sun rose in the east, the dew vanished from the tree leaves.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: After the school shooting, the entire community ______ for the ten students who had died.
= D
~詞義 grieve（v.）哀悼
~原文 After the school shooting, the entire community grieved for the ten students who had died.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Tim wants to study ______ at university because he is interested in the human mind.
= E
~詞義 psychology（n.）心理學
~原文 Tim wants to study psychology at university because he is interested in the human mind.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: This elevator can carry a(n) ______ load of 2,000 kilograms.
= C
~詞義 maximum（adj.）最大量的
~原文 This elevator can carry a(n) maximum load of 2,000 kilograms.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Mrs. Norris is ______ with her son for breaking her favorite vase.
= F
~詞義 furious（adj.）狂怒的
~原文 Mrs. Norris is furious with her son for breaking her favorite vase.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: instinct
B: imposing
C: claws
D: dread
E: rhythm
F: crushing

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Teachers should avoid ______ personal opinions on students and encourage creative thought instead.
= B
~詞義 impose（v.）強加於
~原文 Teachers should avoid imposing personal opinions on students and encourage creative thought instead.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Danny has a very good sense of ______; that is why he is so good at playing the drums.
= E
~詞義 rhythm（n.）節奏
~原文 Danny has a very good sense of rhythm; that is why he is so good at playing the drums.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Whenever Ron thinks of the final exam, his heart fills with ______.
= D
~詞義 dread（n.）恐懼
~原文 Whenever Ron thinks of the final exam, his heart fills with dread.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: My cat has long ______. I have to be careful when I play with her, or else I might get scratched.
= C
~詞義 claw（n.）爪子
~原文 My cat has long claws. I have to be careful when I play with her, or else I might get scratched.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: It is a natural human ______ to want to pursue happiness and avoid pain.
= A
~詞義 instinct（n.）本能
~原文 It is a natural human instinct to want to pursue happiness and avoid pain.
